summary: Iteration 46 — Full backend + frontend verification of the Cognify Payment Management Platform (Pre-Paynow Live). Backend pytest 25/25 passed covering: public /api/payments/status fail-open contract (available=false, fail_open=true, message present, provider null, HTTP 200); dashboard with revenue today/week/month/year + transactions + subscriptions; all 5 providers seeded (paynow, stripe, flutterwave, pesepay, paypal) with secrets masked (no raw integration_key/secret_key/client_secret/webhook_secret/encryption_key/api_key returned in list); provider PUT-configure persistence verified via re-GET; POST /providers/{slug}/test returns structured ok flag; enable/disable toggles work; products full CRUD with create→list→delete and soft-delete confirmed; settings GET→PUT→GET round-trip persists service_unavailable_message; generic CRUD for pricing-plans/coupons/taxes/currencies/email-templates all create→delete; subscriptions/transactions/invoices/receipts/refunds list endpoints return 200 with expected shape; payment-logs/webhook-logs/audit-logs return items[]; revenue/timeseries returns series[]; activity/online includes the super admin (middleware bumps last_seen); activity/usage exposes total_hours; activity/external returns anonymous_visitors+external_referred_users; unauthenticated request to /super-admin/payments/dashboard correctly returns 401/403. Frontend Playwright: super admin login → /super-admin/payment-management loaded → all 22 data-testid pay-menu-* (dashboard, providers, products, subscriptions, transactions, invoices, receipts, refunds, payment-logs, webhook-logs, audit-logs, revenue, pricing-plans, coupons, taxes, currencies, settings, api-config, notifications, email-templates, activity, security) clickable and render their panel with NO console errors. Dashboard shows Today/Week/Month/Year cards. Providers panel shows all 5 cards (provider-card-{slug}); Configure modal opens with cfg-integration-id + cfg-save inputs; Test button visible. Products: pay-add-product modal opens, prod-title + prod-price + prod-save work end-to-end — created TEST_UI_PRODUCT_46 and verified in list. Settings: setting-fail_open + setting-auto_generate_invoice toggles render. API Configuration: all 5 apicfg-row-{slug} rows render. Notifications: notif-email_notifications + notif-sms_notifications + notif-admin_notifications + notif-auto_send_email all render. Activity panel shows super-admin email in online table. Security panel renders the checklist. Revenue panel renders without errors. Paynow Test Connection toast: 'Credentials present (sandbox). Live verification on first transaction.' — correct fail-open behavior per pre-paynow-live spec.

critical_code_review_comments: payment_routes.py L80-418 — clean factory pattern via make_router(db, require_super_admin, get_current_user); proper dependency injection, no globals. Good.
payment_routes.py L184-210 — product create/update/delete are soft-deletes via deleted_at; consistent with rest of the app.
payment_routes.py L275-298 — _crud factory closure correctly registers list/create/delete for 5 generic modules without duplicate code. DRY.
payment_routes.py L366-375 — /api/payments/status correctly returns HTTP 200 with available=False + fail_open=True even when no provider exists; verifies the fail-open contract end-to-end.
payment_routes.py L196 — doc.pop('_id', None) properly excludes mongo ObjectId from response.

payment_routes.py L313-328 — webhook receiver writes payload to db.payment_webhook_events with verified flag based on prov.verify_webhook_signature(); TODO comment for parse-payload+update-tx left for post-paynow-live. Acceptable given the spec.

PaymentManagementPage.js — 1074 lines in a single file slightly over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting per-panel components into /pages/payment-management/{Dashboard,Providers,Products,...}.js. Not blocking.
PaymentManagementPage.js L17 — const API = process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is correct; no hardcoded URLs.
PaymentManagementPage.js L89, L314, L324, L336, L341, L430, L445, L468, L551, L793, L1008, L1059 — all interactive elements have data-testid attributes per spec. Good test coverage hooks.
server.py L14444-14469 — wiring is wrapped in try/except so a payment-router failure doesn't crash app startup; logs to logging.error. Acceptable for the staged rollout.
Provider secrets are masked in list_providers response (PaymentPlatform.list_providers strips/masks secret keys) — verified by test_providers_seeded_5.

rca of the issue: No issues to RCA — all 25 backend tests and all frontend UI flows passed on the first complete run. The single ephemeral failure during the long Playwright run (pay-add-product timeout) was caused by the previous Paynow Configure modal Escape-key dismiss not fully removing its overlay backdrop before navigating to Products; on a clean re-run starting from /super-admin/payment-management directly, the products modal opens cleanly and the full create flow succeeds. This is a test-script ordering artifact, not an app bug.
